scope: Three public ME1 squad journeys: Garrus/Wrex, Liara/Tali and Ashley/Kaidan. Explicit Node-prepared fixtures place all six recruited companions after Therum and before Virmire. The browser selects each pair aboard Normandy, imports a separately declared Feros deployment, issues real native shots and compares actual exported saves after public reload/Continue in one browser process. A final complete Chromium shutdown/restart verifies the final party, loadout, inventory and journal through public UI only: no download after that restart is claimed. Current system Chromium154 crashes on a minimal Blob download after restart without this game; that isolated runtime diagnostic is preserved. This journey does not force all24 poses, certify1:1 likeness or claim played-through recruitment.

limitations: Recruitment and completed chapters are prepared with native Node state functions, not played through in Chromium.
Feros deployment changes only zone/position in a separately declared valid fixture based on the latest actual export.
Combat is intentionally left unresolved, then the real pre-combat automatic save is resumed. No encounter reward is claimed.
Only public native actions occur here; no exact24-pose coverage is inferred from ordinary combat screenshots.
Canvas reads inspect actual WebGL pixels but do not expose private world/actor objects or certify original likeness.

An independent minimal Blob diagnostic reproduces a system Chromium154 crash on a new download after full restart. Exact JSON roundtrips here follow public reloads in the first process; the final full restart is checked via visible UI, without a new export.
